# CANDIDATE: VOL_CONTRACT_BREAKOUT_WITH_VOLUME_SPIKE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of ATR contraction and declining volume, a breakout above the prior 20‑bar high on expanding volume signals a continuation move. This edge exists because low volatility and low volume often precede a period of increased participation and momentum, and a volume‑spike breakout captures the influx of new buyers/sellers that can drive the price further in the breakout direction.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When ATR(14) has been lower than its value 5 bars ago for three consecutive bars AND volume has been below its 20‑bar average for three consecutive bars, wait for a bar that closes above the highest high of the last 20 bars with volume > 1.5× the 20‑bar average volume; go long at that bar’s close. Exit shape: Initial stop at the lowest low of the prior 20 bars; TP1 at 2×R; runner uses a chandelier trail set at 3×ATR(22) below the highest‑since‑entry price. Regime hint: VIX between 15 and 25, time after 10:00 EST to avoid opening‑range noise, and before 15:30 EST to avoid late‑day flattening.
